story:
Why this one matters: Thursday opened Week 2 in Buffalo. Sunday Night is supposed to close the window in Kansas City. The window is still open.

CBS, FOX and the Tennessean all list Colts at Chiefs, 8:20 p.m. ET, NBC, GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium. The same boards still list every other Sunday game as a time, not a final. The only printed Week 2 score remains Bills 41, Lions 31.

Do not print a Colts-Chiefs score. The game has not been played. Monday Night, Giants at Rams on 21 September, is the same: listed, not kicked.
stakes: A Sunday Night date in Kansas City is not a result. Week 2 is still open.
rivalryAngle: AFC hosts, AFC visitors, a listed kickoff instead of a box score.
